name: Wrong Number
overview: Wrong Number is a captivating online web series that tells the love story of two strangers brought together by a unexpected phone call. This lesbian web series follows their journey as they navigate the pain of lost love and forbidden desires, uncovering dark secrets and dangerous lies along the way. Watch their journey in this Thriller web series that explores the power of human connection and the complexities of love in the modern world.
